description: Complete F4 tactical map symbol library. Version 2 adds rectangles, lines, and dots with color_role support.

color_roles.fill: Team color (opaque) used for outline-only objectives and filled interiors
color_roles.fill_blend: Team color at 85% alpha for overlapping translucency
color_roles.outline: Contrasting outline color (typically black or white)

mapping_notes.objective_types: Maps 1:1 to FreeFalcon ObjectiveType enum values
mapping_notes.frame_composition: Ground=battalion/brigade frame, Air=squadron frame, Naval=task_force frame. Glyphs are frame-agnostic.

symbols.description: Runway: circle with intersecting runway line
Short runway: circle with two crossing runway lines
Flag: vertical pole with triangular flag
Truss bridge: two bars with vertical supports
Diamond with X: chemical weapons storage
Cluster of 3 buildings of varying heights
Square with two antenna lines and dots
Box with two chimneys on top
Square with horizontal lines: river crossing
Trefoil: nuclear facility with 3 radial blades
Two triangles with gap: mountain pass
Anchor: ring, shaft, and horizontal bar
Triangle with dot and emission arcs
